{{Quote|Before they could get it sorted out, I fired up ''Mama''{{'s}} tractor beam and started slingshotting chunks of ice from the ring into them.|Lando Calrissian, to [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], on the Battle of Taanab|<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Mama Tried''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was flown by the [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Calrissian stopped over on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taanab/Legends|Taanab]] whilst carrying a cargo of [[conner net]]s aboard the ''Mama''. After Taanab was [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Norulac Freebooters]], Calrissian made a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] bet that he could defeat the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] single-handedly, and he powered up the ''Mama'' and flew into combat. After Calrissian ejected the connor nets and the pirates became entangled in the devices, and Calrissian then used the ''Mama''{{'s}} [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] to hurl chunks of ice at the stricken freebooters.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Mama Tried'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] guidebook ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], and the vessel's name was intended as a reference to the song "[[Wikipedia:Mama Tried (song)|Mama Tried]]," by the musician [[Wikipedia:Merle Haggard|Merle Haggard]].<ref name="Warfare Endnotes">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25364458982/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-12|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 12}}</ref>
